hit.Label: Hit
hit.Hint: The attack hit at least one target.

crit.Label: Critical
crit.Hint: The attack was a critical hit; it also counts as a hit.

fumble.Label: Fumble
fumble.Hint: The attack roll was a natural fumble.

failed.Label: Failed
failed.Hint: The target failed its saving throw.

succeeded.Label: Succeeded
succeeded.Hint: The target succeeded on its saving throw.

dealt.Label: Damage dealt
dealt.Hint: Damage was applied to a target.

dropped.Label: Dropped to 0
dropped.Hint: The damage reduced a target to 0 hit points.

success.Label: Success
success.Hint: The check met or beat its DC.

failure.Label: Failure
failure.Hint: The check fell short of its DC.

then.Label: And then
then.Hint: Continues once this result has been applied.

Connect.missingNode: One of these nodes no longer exists.
Connect.selfLoop: A node cannot connect to itself.
Connect.intoEvent: Events start a chain; nothing can lead into them.
Connect.fromResult: This result has no outputs. Turn on “And then” in its settings to continue from it.
Connect.unknownPin: This output does not exist on the node.
Connect.cycle: This wire would create a loop.

reach.label: Whose roll
reach.hint: Who has to make the roll for this event to fire.

reachMode.label: Source
reachMode.hint: Me only, creatures in my aura, creatures in my template, or creatures in this region.

reachRange.label: Aura radius (ft)
reachRange.hint: A number or a formula such as @abilities.cha.mod * 5. Use -1 for an unlimited range.

reachDisposition.label: Affects
reachDisposition.hint: Which creatures, by token disposition, the aura or template affects.

reachIncludeSelf.label: Also affects me
reachIncludeSelf.hint: When off, only other creatures benefit.

reachBlockers.label: Suppressed by
reachBlockers.hint: The aura stops while I have any of these conditions.

reachRequire.label: Blocked by walls that block
reachRequire.hint: The aura only reaches creatures not cut off by such walls.

signalName.label: Signal name
signalName.hint: Any short name. Senders and receivers must use exactly the same one.

conditionMode.label: Pass when
conditionMode.hint: All checks must pass, or any single one is enough.

anyOf.label: Matches
anyOf.hint: Pick one or more values; the check passes if any of them matches.
anyOf.hintExclusion: Pick one or more values. Mark a value as excluded to require that it does not match.

tags.label: Values
tags.hint: Type a value and press Enter; letters, digits and dashes.

optional.label: Ask the player
optional.hint: The player opts in from the roll dialog instead of it applying automatically.

choiceGroup.label: Shared choice
choiceGroup.hint: Results with the same name are offered as one choice with one cost. Leave empty to keep this result separate.

cost.label: Cost
cost.hint: What the player spends to opt in.

costType.label: Pay with
costType.hint: The resource spent when the player opts in.

costMin.label: Minimum
costMin.hint: The smallest amount to spend. Formulas are allowed.

costMax.label: Maximum
costMax.hint: Leave empty to allow as much as is available.

costStep.label: Step
costStep.hint: The increment between the minimum and maximum.

costScales.label: Scales with the amount paid
costScales.hint: Each step above the minimum adds the formula below.

costFormula.label: Scaling formula
costFormula.hint: Added once per step above the minimum, e.g. 1d8.

limit.label: At most
limit.hint: The result does not apply again within the period.

conditionThisItem.label: Only rolls with this item
conditionThisItem.hint: The condition passes only for rolls made with the item that carries this blueprint, whatever the checks below say.

regionTokens.label: Which tokens
regionTokens.hint: Tokens that set this off, by their disposition.

turnReach.label: Whose turn
turnReach.hint: Whose turn sets this off: mine, or the turn of a creature in my aura.

turnReachMode.hint: Me only, or creatures in my aura.

then.label: “And then” output
then.hint: Continue the chain once this result has been applied: the player chose it, its limit allowed it and no module stopped it.

counterScope.label: Kind
counterScope.hint: Shared by the actor's blueprints, or private to this one.

attackRoll.Label: Attack roll
attackRoll.Summary: Before an attack roll is made.
attackRoll.Help: Fires while an attack roll is being prepared, so results can still change it. Example: +1 to hit with a magic weapon.

out.Self: when I make an attack roll

damageRoll.Label: Damage roll
damageRoll.Help: Fires while a damage roll is being prepared. Example: +1d6 fire damage with a flame tongue.

saveDC.Label: Save DC
saveDC.Summary: When one of my activities forces a saving throw.
saveDC.Help: Changes the DC creatures must beat when my spell or feature forces a save. Example: +1 to spell save DC from a rod of the pact keeper.

out.Self: when I force a saving throw

savingThrow.Label: Saving throw
savingThrow.Summary: Before a saving throw is rolled, including death and concentration saves.
savingThrow.Help: Example: add the paladin's Charisma modifier to the saves of nearby allies.

out.Self: when I make a saving throw

abilityCheck.Label: Ability check
abilityCheck.Summary: Before an ability, skill or tool check.
abilityCheck.Help: Example: +1d4 to Stealth while wearing a cloak of elvenkind.

out.Self: when I make an ability check

hitDie.Label: Hit die
hitDie.Summary: Before a hit die is rolled during a rest.
hitDie.Help: Example: reroll 1s on hit dice with the Durable feat.

out.Self: when I roll a hit die

afterAttack.Label: After an attack
afterAttack.Summary: When an attack roll is resolved: hit, miss, critical or fumble.
afterAttack.Help: Use the outcome pins to react. With Midi QOL the hits come from its workflow; without it the roll is compared with the targets' AC. Example: on a hit, apply Poisoned.

hit.Self: when I hit with an attack

miss.Self: when I miss with an attack

crit.Self: when I score a critical hit

afterTargetSave.Label: After a target's save
afterTargetSave.Summary: When a target resolves a save my activity asked for.
afterTargetSave.Help: Example: when the target fails, knock it prone.

failed.Self: when a target fails a save against me
failed.Other: when a target fails a save against {who}

succeeded.Self: when a target succeeds on a save against me
succeeded.Other: when a target succeeds on a save against {who}

afterDamage.Label: After damage
afterDamage.Summary: When my damage is applied to a target.
afterDamage.Help: The "Dropped to 0" pin fires when the damage leaves the target at 0 HP. Example: gain temporary hit points when you drop a foe.

dropped.Self: when I drop a target to 0 HP
dropped.Other: when {who} drops a target to 0 HP

afterCheck.Label: After a check
afterCheck.Summary: When my ability check with a known DC is resolved.
afterCheck.Help: Only checks with a DC can succeed or fail. Example: on a failed Athletics check, gain a bonus to the next one.

success.Self: when I succeed on an ability check
success.Other: when {who} succeeds on an ability check

failure.Self: when I fail an ability check

signal.Label: Signal received
signal.Summary: When another blueprint sends a signal with this name.
signal.Help: Signals let one blueprint trigger another. The receiver sees the same roll and targets as the sender. Example: a "smite" signal shared by several items.

turnStart.Label: Turn start
turnStart.Summary: When a turn starts in combat.
turnStart.Help: Fires once per turn, on the GM's side. Use results that do not change a roll: effects, resources, reminders, a bonus to a later roll. Example: regenerate 10 hit points at the start of my turn.

turnEnd.Label: Turn end
turnEnd.Summary: When a turn ends in combat.
turnEnd.Help: Fires once per turn, on the GM's side. Example: at the end of my turn, poison damage.

regionEnter.Label: Enters the region
regionEnter.Summary: When a token enters this region.
regionEnter.Help: Only on regions. The creature that entered is "me" for checks and results. Example: a hostile creature entering the cloud is poisoned.

regionExit.Label: Leaves the region
regionExit.Summary: When a token leaves this region.
regionExit.Help: Only on regions. Example: remove the effect the region gave on entering.

shortRest.Label: Short rest
shortRest.Help: Not fired by a long rest; wire both events when both should count.

out.Self: when I finish a short rest

longRest.Label: Long rest
longRest.Help: Example: restore a use of a feature, or remove an effect.

out.Self: when I finish a long rest

itemTypes.Label: Item type
itemTypes.Summary: The item being used is of one of these types.

identifiers.Label: Item identifier
identifiers.Summary: The item's identifier is one of these.
identifiers.Help: Identifiers are the short names dnd5e gives items, such as longsword or fire-bolt. Example: fire-bolt.

baseWeapons.Label: Weapon
baseWeapons.Help: Example: longswords and shortswords, but not greatswords.

weaponProperties.Label: Weapon property
weaponProperties.Summary: The weapon has one of these properties.

attackModes.Label: Attack mode
attackModes.Summary: Melee or ranged, weapon or spell, and how the weapon was used.
attackModes.Help: Example: ranged weapon attacks made by throwing the weapon.

featureTypes.Label: Feature type
featureTypes.Summary: The feature is of this type and subtype.
featureTypes.Help: Example: class features of the Channel Divinity subtype.

damageTypes.Label: Damage type
damageTypes.Summary: The damage or healing includes one of these types.
damageTypes.Help: Example: fire or cold, but not healing.

abilities.Label: Ability
abilities.Summary: The roll uses one of these abilities.

thisItem.Label: This item only
thisItem.Summary: The roll is made with the item that carries this blueprint.
thisItem.Help: Use it so a bonus on a sword does not apply to the axe in your other hand.
thisItem.Phrase: the roll uses this very item

spellLevels.Label: Spell level
spellLevels.Summary: The spell is cast at one of these levels.

spellSchools.Label: Spell school
spellSchools.Summary: The spell belongs to one of these schools.
spellSchools.Help: Example: evocation, as for the Empowered Evocation feature.

spellComponents.Label: Spell components
spellComponents.Help: Example: spells with a verbal component.

Field.typesHint: Verbal, somatic, material and other spell properties.
Field.matchHint: Any one of them, or all of them.

preparationModes.Label: Spellcasting method
preparationModes.Summary: The spell is cast through one of these methods.

sourceClasses.Label: Spell source class
sourceClasses.Summary: The spell comes from one of these classes.
sourceClasses.Help: Enter class identifiers such as wizard or cleric.

actorCreatureTypes.Label: My creature type
actorCreatureTypes.Summary: I am a creature of one of these types.

actorCreatureSizes.Label: My size
actorCreatureSizes.Summary: I am one of these sizes.

actorLanguages.Label: My languages
actorLanguages.Summary: I know one of these languages.

baseArmors.Label: My armor
baseArmors.Summary: I wear one of these armors or shields.
baseArmors.Help: Example: no heavy armor, for a Monk feature.

statusEffects.Label: My conditions
statusEffects.Summary: I have one of these conditions.
statusEffects.Help: Condition immunities are respected. Example: while raging.

healthPercentages.Label: My hit points
healthPercentages.Summary: My hit points are above or below a percentage.
healthPercentages.Help: Temporary hit points are not counted. Example: at most 50% for a Bloodied feature.

Phrase.atMost: I have at most {value}% of my hit points
Phrase.atLeast: I have at least {value}% of my hit points

remainingSpellSlots.Label: My spell slots
remainingSpellSlots.Summary: I have a number of spell slots left within a range.
remainingSpellSlots.Help: Example: at most 1 slot left, for a desperate-caster feature.

Phrase.min: I have at least {min} spell slots left
Phrase.max: I have at most {max} spell slots left

remainingSpellSlots.PhraseAny: I have any number of spell slots

Field.minHint: Leave empty for no lower limit.
Field.maxHint: Leave empty for no upper limit.

proficiencyLevels.Label: My proficiency
proficiencyLevels.Summary: I have this level of proficiency in the roll.

markers.Label: My markers
markers.Summary: I, my item or my effects carry one of these markers.
markers.Help: Markers are simple tags that other blueprints and macros can set. Example: hexblade-curse.

creatureTypes.Label: Target creature type
creatureTypes.Summary: The target is a creature of one of these types.

targetArmors.Label: Target armor
targetArmors.Summary: The target wears one of these armors.

targetEffects.Label: Target conditions
targetEffects.Summary: The target has one of these conditions.
targetEffects.Help: Example: a bonus against prone targets.

tokenSizes.Label: Target size
tokenSizes.Summary: The target's token is at least or at most a size.
tokenSizes.Help: Example: Large or bigger, for Giant Killer.

Phrase.atMost: the target is at most {size}×{size} squares
Phrase.atLeast: the target is at least {size}×{size} squares

Field.sizeHint: Token width in grid squares, e.g. 2 for Large.
Field.selfHint: Use my own token as the bound when it is stricter.

targetMarkers.Label: Target markers
targetMarkers.Summary: The target carries one of these markers.

saveAbilities.Label: Save DC ability
saveAbilities.Summary: The DC of the save my activity forces is set by one of these abilities.
saveAbilities.Help: Example: a Battle Master who sets maneuver DCs with Dexterity. For spells, the spellcasting ability counts.

throwTypes.Label: Saving throw type
throwTypes.Summary: The saving throw is of one of these kinds.
throwTypes.Help: Includes death saves and concentration. Example: concentration only.

skillIds.Label: Skill
skillIds.Summary: The check uses one of these skills.
skillIds.Help: Example: Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

baseTools.Label: Tool
baseTools.Summary: The check uses one of these tools.

arbitraryComparisons.Label: Compare values
arbitraryComparisons.Summary: Compare two formulas; every comparison must hold.
arbitraryComparisons.Help: Formulas can use roll data such as @abilities.str.mod and @target.attributes.ac.value. Example: @target.attributes.hp.value < 10.

customScripts.Label: Custom script
customScripts.Summary: A JavaScript snippet that returns true or false.
customScripts.Help: For advanced users. The GM can disable scripts in the module settings.

Field.scriptHint: Available variables: actor, item, activity, target, details.

counter.Label: Counter
counter.Summary: Compare a counter with a number.
counter.Help: An unknown counter counts as its initial value (0).

Field.name: Counter
Field.nameHint: Its name; capitals and spaces do not matter.

rollBonus.Label: Roll bonus
rollBonus.Summary: Add a formula to the roll.
rollBonus.Help: On damage rolls the bonus can have a damage type. Example: +1d6 fire.

Field.formulaHint: A number, dice or roll data, e.g. 1d4 or @abilities.cha.mod.
Field.damageTypesHint: Several types let the player pick one.

dcBonus.Label: Save DC bonus
dcBonus.Summary: Raise or lower the DC of the save I force.
dcBonus.Help: Example: +1 from a rod of the pact keeper.

Field.formulaHint: Positive raises the DC, negative lowers it.

diceModifiers.Label: Dice modifiers
diceModifiers.Summary: Reroll, explode, clamp or resize the dice.
diceModifiers.Help: Example: Great Weapon Fighting rerolls 1s and 2s once.

Field.amountHint: Change how many dice are rolled.
Field.rerollHint: Reroll dice at or below the threshold.
Field.explodeHint: Roll an extra die when a die reaches the threshold.
Field.minimumHint: No die rolls lower than this.
Field.maximumHint: No die rolls higher than this.
Field.firstOnlyHint: Change only the first dice in the formula.

critRange.Label: Critical range
critRange.Summary: Widen or narrow critical hits and fumbles.
critRange.Help: Example: -1 for Improved Critical (critical hits on 19–20).

Field.criticalHint: Negative numbers make critical hits easier.
Field.fumbleHint: Positive numbers make fumbles more likely.

critDamage.Label: Critical damage
critDamage.Summary: Extra dice or damage on critical hits.
critDamage.Help: Example: +1 extra die for Brutal Critical.

Field.diceHint: How many extra weapon dice to roll.
Field.damageHint: A formula added only on a critical hit.

saveThresholds.Label: Save thresholds
saveThresholds.Summary: Change what counts as a success or a critical death save.
saveThresholds.Help: Example: death saves succeed on 8 or higher (-2 to the threshold).
saveThresholds.PhraseDeath: {value} to the death save critical threshold

Field.deathSaveCriticalHint: Negative numbers make a critical death save easier.

reminder.Label: Reminder
reminder.Summary: Show a note: in the roll dialog, or in chat where there is none.
reminder.Help: Nothing is applied automatically. Example: "You have advantage against being charmed."

Field.textHint: Shown to the player while rolling.

rider.Label: Bonus to a later roll
rider.Summary: Carry a roll change forward to a later roll.
rider.Help: Example: after a hit, +2d6 to this attack's damage roll.

Phrase.sameActivation: {effect} for the rest of this activation

Field.effectHint: The roll change to carry forward.
Field.scopeHint: The rest of this activation, or the next roll of a kind.
Field.durationHint: When the change expires if it is not used.

applyEffect.Label: Apply effect
applyEffect.Summary: Apply a condition or one of this item's effects.
applyEffect.Help: Changes to other creatures are made by the GM's client. Example: on a failed save, apply Frightened.

Field.sourceHint: A condition from the list, or an effect stored on this item.
Field.effectIdHint: Effects defined on the item that carries this blueprint.

removeEffect.Label: Remove effect
removeEffect.Summary: Remove a condition or a named effect.
removeEffect.Help: Example: when you hit, end your own Invisible condition.

Field.name: Effect name
Field.nameHint: The exact name of the effect.

resource.Label: Resources
resource.Summary: Spend or restore uses, slots, hit points and more.
resource.Help: Example: on a kill, gain 5 temporary hit points.

signal.Label: Send signal
signal.Summary: Trigger blueprints listening for this signal.
signal.Help: Receivers run with the same roll and targets. Example: one "smite" chain shared by several weapons.

Field.name: Signal name
Field.scopeHint: Blueprints on my whole actor, or only on this document.

demandSave.Label: Demand a saving throw
demandSave.Summary: Make the target, me or my aura roll a save; continue on success or failure.
demandSave.Help: The owner rolls in their own dialog; after 30 seconds, or without a connected owner, the GM rolls. Example: on a hit, a Constitution save against poison.

Field.dcModeHint: A number or formula, or my spell save DC.

Phrase.target: the target makes a {ability} saving throw, {dc}
Phrase.aura: creatures in my aura ({range} ft) make a {ability} saving throw, {dc}

counter.Label: Change counter
counter.Summary: Add to, subtract from, set or reset a named counter.
counter.Help: Counters are numbers on an actor: rage charges, curse stacks, hits in a row. Use them in checks and in formulas as @counters.name.

Field.name: Counter
Field.nameHint: Its name; capitals and spaces do not matter.
Field.amountHint: A number or formula, rounded down.

condition.Label: Condition
condition.Summary: Check the item, the target, the roll or me before continuing.

Palette.label: Add a node
Palette.empty: No node matches “{query}”. Try another word.
Palette.fromHint: Only nodes that can follow this output are shown.

Inspector.label: Node settings
Inspector.emptyBody: Click a node on the canvas to edit it, or press Space to add one.
Inspector.noChecks: Add the first check. Without checks this node always passes.
Inspector.irrelevantCheck: This check never passes after the events wired into this node.
Inspector.unknown: This node type is not available in this version.

Stamp.label: Blueprint title block
Stamp.name: Blueprint name
Stamp.emptyPhrase: Connect an event to a result to see what this blueprint does.
Stamp.effectDisabled: Off: the blueprint does not work now
Stamp.effectSuppressed: Suppressed: the item is not equipped, or the effect does not apply to its actor
Stamp.effectExpired: Ended: its duration is over, for example by a DAE special duration; the blueprint does not work

Canvas.label: Blueprint canvas
Canvas.nodeHelp: Press Enter or Space to select a node, then use the arrow keys to move it. Delete removes it; Ctrl+D duplicates it; Escape cancels.
Canvas.edgeHelp: Press Enter or Space to select a wire. Delete removes it; Escape cancels.

Stage.emptyBody: A blueprint connects an event to results, with checks in between when you need them.

Issues.empty: No issues. Wiring, formulas and signals are checked as you edit.

Sim.noActors: Add an actor to the world to test with.
Sim.noEvents: Add an event to test this blueprint.
Sim.noteSuppressed: The carrier is switched off (an unequipped item or an inactive effect), so this blueprint is ignored in play.
Sim.noteNoToken: The actor has no token on this scene, so auras, templates and regions cannot reach it.
Sim.noteTrigger: In play this runs on the GM's side: at a turn in combat, when a token enters or leaves the region, or after a rest.
Sim.noteChosen: Steps after “And then” on a player's choice are shown as if the player chose it.

Coach.canvasBody: Right-click the canvas or press Space to add a node. Drag from a pin to wire it to the next node; drop a wire on empty space to pick what comes next.
Coach.inspectorBody: Every field explains itself. The ? button shows an example.
Coach.stampBody: The title block says in plain words what this blueprint does and marks anything to fix.
Coach.testBody: ▶ runs the blueprint on an actor and target you choose and shows why each check passed or failed.

Picker.label: Start from a template
Picker.emptyLibrary: The library is empty. Save a blueprint to it from the list, or import a JSON file.
Picker.importFailed: This file is not JSON. Choose a file exported from Build-n-Action.

Counters.title: Counters
Counters.addOwn: Add a counter to this blueprint
Counters.noOwner: This blueprint has no owning actor, so it has no shared counters.
Counters.name: Name

Reason.empty: Nothing is selected, so this always passes.
Reason.noActivity: The roll has no activity of that kind.
Reason.notSpell: The item is not a spell.
Reason.notWeapon: The item is not a weapon.
Reason.notFeature: The item is a {actual}, not a feature.
Reason.noValue: This roll does not provide that value.
Reason.scriptError: The script stopped with an error.
Reason.scriptDisabled: Scripts are turned off in the module settings, so this passes.
Reason.otherItem: The roll uses a different item.
Reason.noChecks: No checks, so this always passes.
Reason.outOfReach: The roller is out of reach: {actual}.

Lint.orphan-node: Nothing leads into this node, so it never runs.
Lint.dead-event: This event does not lead to any result.
Lint.incompatible-result: This result cannot follow the “{event}” event.
Lint.irrelevant-check: This check never passes after the “{event}” event.
Lint.unknown-path: {path} does not exist in the roll data.
Lint.contradiction: This check contradicts an earlier check of the same kind, so the condition can never pass.
Lint.signal-unmatched: No blueprint here both sends and receives the signal “{name}”.
Lint.cost-without-optional: A cost needs “Ask the player” turned on.
Lint.migrated: Converted from the previous version. Check that it works as expected.
Lint.item-tick-off-item: This blueprint is not on an item, so “Only rolls with this item” has no effect here.
Lint.optional-on-trigger: There is no roll dialog to ask in here, so this result applies at once and its cost is not paid.
Lint.region-event-off-region: This event only fires on a region; this blueprint is not on one.
Lint.counter-unknown: No counter “{name}” is set up; it works with default settings.

Warning.invalidId: The bonus had an invalid id and received a new one.
Warning.unknownFilter: The filter “{filter}” is not supported and was left out.
Warning.unknownType: The bonus type “{type}” is not supported and was not converted.

Migration.title: Migrate the world to blueprints
Migration.intro: Converts every v1 bonus in this world's actors, items, effects, regions and templates into a blueprint. The originals are kept as backups until you delete them, and running this again converts nothing twice. Start with a scan: it changes nothing.
Migration.scanSummary: Found {documents} document(s) to update: {converted} v1 bonus(es) will convert, {repaired} migrated blueprint(s) will be repaired, {failed} cannot be read.
Migration.doneSummary: Updated {documents} document(s): {converted} bonus(es) converted, {repaired} blueprint(s) repaired, {failed} left as they were, {errors} error(s).
Migration.nothing: Nothing left to convert or repair.
Migration.deleteBackupsConfirm: Delete the kept v1 originals from every document? Converted blueprints stay. This cannot be undone.

Storage.invalidBlueprint: A saved blueprint is damaged and was skipped (problem at “{path}”).

disableScripts.name: Turn off script checks
disableScripts.hint: Script checks in conditions pass without running their code. Turn this on if you do not trust scripts in shared content.

fumbleBelowOne.name: Allow removing fumbles
fumbleBelowOne.hint: Blueprints may lower the fumble range below 1, so a natural 1 is no longer a fumble.

padAuraRadius.name: Measure auras from the token's edge
padAuraRadius.hint: On gridless scenes, add half the source token's size to aura ranges, as gridded scenes always do.

showAuraRanges.name: Show aura ranges
showAuraRanges.hint: Draw aura shapes on the canvas while a roll checks them.

allowPlayers.name: Let players edit blueprints
allowPlayers.hint: Players can open the blueprint editor on documents they own. The GM can always edit.

headerLabel.name: Show the Build-n-Action button in the title bar
headerLabel.hint: Besides the entry in each sheet's header menu, show a Build-n-Action button in the window's title bar.

migration.name: Migrate the world
migration.label: Open the migration
migration.hint: Convert every v1 bonus in the world (and chosen compendiums) into blueprints, with a dry run first.

showSheetTab.name: Blueprints tab on character sheets
showSheetTab.hint: Kept from v1 for a later version; it has no effect yet.

Runtime.NoGM: No GM is online, so a blueprint could not change a creature you do not own.
Runtime.RemoteFailed: The GM could not make every change a blueprint asked for. See the console for details.

Panel.CannotPay: This cost can no longer be paid.

Editor.title: Blueprints: {name}
Editor.loadFailed: The blueprint editor could not load. The console (F12) has the details.
Editor.saveFailed: A blueprint could not be saved. Your edit is still in the editor; the console (F12) has the details.
Editor.noPermission: You cannot edit blueprints on this document.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Put it on the blessed creature's effect: +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

bane.name: Bane
bane.description: Put it on the effect of each creature under Bane: −1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: +1d6 necrotic damage against a target that carries the marker “hex”. Give the cursed creature an effect with that marker.

huntersMark.name: Hunter's Mark
huntersMark.description: +1d6 force damage on weapon attacks against a target with the marker “hunters-mark”.

sneakAttack.name: Sneak Attack
sneakAttack.description: Once per turn, add your Sneak Attack dice to a finesse or ranged weapon attack. The player decides in the roll dialog.

greatWeapon.name: Great Weapon Fighting
greatWeapon.description: With a two-handed or versatile weapon held in two hands, damage dice that roll 1 or 2 count as 3.

archery.name: Archery Fighting Style
archery.description: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

brutalCritical.name: Brutal Critical
brutalCritical.description: One extra weapon die on a critical hit with a melee weapon.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: Reminds the player of Luck Points on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws.
lucky.reminder: Lucky: spend a Luck Point to roll with advantage.

auraOfProtection.name: Aura of Protection
auraOfProtection.description: Allies within 10 ft add your Charisma modifier (at least +1) to saving throws while you are not incapacitated.

divineSmite.name: Divine Smite
divineSmite.description: On a melee weapon hit, spend a spell slot for 2d8 radiant damage, +1d8 per slot level above 1st. Against fiends and undead, also take the second choice for +1d8.

colossusSlayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossusSlayer.description: Once per turn, +1d8 weapon damage against a target that is below its hit point maximum.

poisonedBlade.name: Poisoned Blade
poisonedBlade.description: On a hit against a living creature, the player may poison the target, once per turn.

vampiricStrike.name: Vampiric Strike
